title: Route 66 Centennial Commission Act
official_summary:
Route 66 Centennial Commission Act

This bill establishes the Route 66 Centennial Commission to honor U.S. Route 66 on the occasion of its centennial anniversary.

The bill sets forth the duties of the commission, its membership, powers, and reporting requirements.

The commission shall terminate on December 31, 2026.

summary.headline: Creates a federal commission to commemorate the 100th anniversary of U.S. Route 66, set to end on December 31, 2026.
summary.what_it_does: The law sets up the Route 66 Centennial Commission to honor U.S. Route 66 as it marks its 100th anniversary. It describes the commission's duties, how its members are chosen, what powers it has, and what it must report. The commission ends on December 31, 2026.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2020; the commission terminates December 31, 2026.
